definitions.text: as stated by someone or something
definitions.example: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.

definitions.text: as a result of something
definitions.example: The game was cancelled because of heavy rain.

definitions.text: used to show that two or more people do the same thing to or for one another
definitions.example: The two friends helped each other with homework.

definitions.text: in place of someone or something
definitions.example: I drank water instead of soda.

definitions.text: directly before or ahead of something
definitions.example: There is a tree in front of the house.

definitions.text: beside something or someone
definitions.example: She sat next to her sister.

definitions.text: on the highest surface of something
definitions.example: The keys are on top of the fridge.

definitions.text: away from the inside of something, or no longer having something
definitions.example: He ran out of the room.

definitions.text: because of something
definitions.example: The delay was due to traffic.

definitions.text: except for, or in addition to
definitions.example: Apart from one mistake, the essay was excellent.

definitions.text: in addition to something or someone
definitions.example: She speaks Spanish as well as English.

definitions.text: instead of something, especially when making a choice
definitions.example: I chose to walk rather than wait for the bus.

definitions.text: the basic rights and freedoms that all people should have
definitions.example: The group works to protect human rights.

definitions.text: the amount of carbon gases produced by a person, activity, or product
definitions.example: We tried to reduce our carbon footprint by cycling.

definitions.text: a place at an airport or hotel where you register your arrival
definitions.example: We waited in line at the check-in counter.

definitions.text: a desk where people register when they arrive at a hotel or airport
definitions.example: Please leave your key at the check-in desk.

definitions.text: sports that involve high risk and excitement
definitions.example: Skydiving is one of the most popular extreme sports.

definitions.text: a style of music, dance, and culture that began in urban communities
definitions.example: They listened to hip hop on the way home.

definitions.text: a card that shows a person’s name and identity
definitions.example: You need an id card to enter the building.

definitions.text: a small electronic device for playing digital audio files
definitions.example: He listened to podcasts on his MP3 player.

definitions.text: not harmful to the environment, or less harmful than alternatives
definitions.example: We use environmentally friendly cleaning products.

definitions.text: putting a lot of effort and care into work
definitions.example: She is a hard-working student.

definitions.text: an adult, or behaving like an adult
definitions.example: When I am a grown-up, I want to be a nurse.

definitions.text: to be required to do something
definitions.example: I have to finish this report today.

definitions.text: used to say what is the right or sensible thing to do
definitions.example: You ought to apologize for the mistake.

definitions.text: used to describe something that happened regularly or was true in the past
definitions.example: I used to play football every weekend.

definitions.text: for the purpose of doing something
definitions.example: She studied hard in order to pass the exam.

definitions.text: to make something possible or achieve a result
definitions.example: He spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.

definitions.text: only if a particular condition is true
definitions.example: You can borrow my bike as long as you are careful.

definitions.text: despite the fact that something is true
definitions.example: Even though it was cold, we went swimming.

definitions.text: despite something
definitions.example: They enjoyed the picnic in spite of the wind.

definitions.text: used to introduce a new topic in a conversation
definitions.example: By the way, did you call your brother?

definitions.text: not less than a stated amount, or used to show a small positive point
definitions.example: It will take at least an hour to get there.

definitions.text: after a long wait or delay
definitions.example: At last, the bus arrived.

definitions.text: used to add information that is true or surprising
definitions.example: I thought he was quiet; in fact, he is very funny.

definitions.text: used to give a typical case that explains something
definitions.example: Many fruits, for example apples and oranges, contain vitamin C.

definitions.text: used to introduce examples of something
definitions.example: She enjoys outdoor activities such as hiking and cycling.

definitions.text: before anything else
definitions.example: First of all, let us check the schedule.

definitions.text: used to remind someone of an important fact or explain a result
definitions.example: I decided to walk; after all, it was a nice day.

definitions.text: acceptable, safe, or satisfactory
definitions.example: Is everything all right at home?

definitions.text: used to show that something is obvious or certain
definitions.example: Of course I can help you.

definitions.text: not any more
definitions.example: She no longer lives in that city.

definitions.text: immediately, without delay
definitions.example: Please come here at once.

definitions.text: at the planned or expected time
definitions.example: The train arrived on time.

definitions.text: early enough for something
definitions.example: We got to the airport in time for our flight.

definitions.text: using your hands rather than a machine
definitions.example: The sign was painted by hand.

definitions.text: by walking
definitions.example: We explored the old town on foot.

definitions.text: in one’s house or place where one lives
definitions.example: I stayed at home all day.

definitions.text: in the place where you do your job
definitions.example: She is at work right now.

definitions.text: responsible for something or someone
definitions.example: She is in charge of the new project.

definitions.text: shared by two or more people or things
definitions.example: The two cousins have a lot in common.

definitions.text: at risk of being harmed
definitions.example: The hikers were in danger during the storm.

definitions.text: feeling strong romantic love for someone
definitions.example: They fell in love at university.

definitions.text: not having enough of something necessary, such as help or money
definitions.example: The charity supports families in need.

definitions.text: where other people can see or hear
definitions.example: He does not like speaking in public.

definitions.text: without other people knowing
definitions.example: They planned the surprise in secret.

definitions.text: in a difficult or dangerous situation
definitions.example: He got in trouble for arriving late.

definitions.text: intentionally, not by accident
definitions.example: I did not break it on purpose.

definitions.text: available to buy at a lower price than usual
definitions.example: These shoes are on sale this week.

definitions.text: used to introduce a different or opposite point of view
definitions.example: The job pays well; on the other hand, it is stressful.

definitions.text: used at the beginning of a story to talk about a time long ago
definitions.example: Once upon a time, a dragon lived in the mountains.

definitions.text: to watch, listen, or think carefully
definitions.example: Please pay attention to the instructions.

definitions.text: to be careful, or a friendly way to say goodbye
definitions.example: Take care when you cross the road.

definitions.text: to join in an activity or event
definitions.example: Many students wanted to take part in the competition.

definitions.text: to check or do something so that you are certain
definitions.example: Make sure you lock the door.

definitions.text: to be clear and easy to understand, or reasonable
definitions.example: His explanation makes sense.

definitions.text: to feel pleased and excited about something that will happen
definitions.example: I look forward to seeing you next week.

definitions.text: to have a friendly relationship with someone
definitions.example: She gets on with her colleagues very well.

definitions.text: to accept something unpleasant without complaining
definitions.example: I cannot put up with this noise anymore.
